Jo (billing): important: invoice-preview needs to multiply token_count by weight. Do we round per-event or at aggregate?

Maya (console-ux): UI note: if weight present show 'weighted' badge on preview and add tooltip. Also need admin toggle to view raw event weight.
Jo (billing): also check ledger column types. If DB still INT we need a migration or temporary accumulator.
Rae (ingest): noted; putting in a migration ticket. For rollout we'll cap weight to [0.0001,100] and emit a meter when capping occurs.
Sam K: can we run a 24h replay on snapshot to compare preview deltas before wider rollout?
Jo (billing): yes please. If >0.2% tenants have >$0.50 delta hold.
